svg.aria-label: FoundryIQ documents, blob ingestion, AI Search, knowledge base, and MCP connection

g.text: Arrows show the content and retrieval path, not the order resources are provisioned
Bicep: connection + RBAC. Postprovision: upload, indexer, knowledge source, and knowledge base.
The Toolbox calls the KB MCP endpoint through the Foundry connection; the agent receives grounded tool results.
